author: Pixar YouTube
text:
Cars: Route 66 Road Trip | The Legacy | Episode 4
Join us as we celebrate the Cars 20th anniversary and 100 years of Route 66 while we recreate the original Cars research trip the Pixar team took 25 years ago. @jofranco, travel content creator, visits the famous "Here It Is" sign and picks up Cars' Production Designer (Characters) Bob Pauley. After dropping off Bob in Winslow, Arizona, Jo continues down the mother road to meet with Jay Ward, Character Team Manager and self-proclaimed CARsultant. 

Disney & Pixar’s Cars is racing back into theaters September 4. And watch the Cars Collection now streaming on Disney+.
